bedroom = a room with a bed, used for sleeping
bathroom = a room with a bath or shower and usually a toilet
toilet = a bowl you sit on to get rid of waste; a small room for this
study = a room used for reading or working at a desk
utility room = a small room for the washing machine and cleaning tools
sofa = a long, soft seat for two or more people
armchair = a big comfortable chair with sides for your arms
coffee table = a low table in front of a sofa
bookshelf = a board on the wall or a piece of furniture for books
desk = a table for writing or using a computer
lamp = a device that gives light
mirror = a piece of glass that shows your reflection
rug = a small carpet
pillow = a soft cushion for your head in bed
blanket = a large piece of cloth used as a cover on a bed
duvet = a thick bed cover filled with feathers or similar material
sheet = a large piece of cloth on a mattress
mattress = the thick, soft part of a bed that you lie on
bunk beds = two beds, one above the other
shelf = a flat board for putting things on
